cited_evidence: assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing the demand record_id with the source_id.
Job-2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while Job-2 input needs contains record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Observed Job-2 priorities all have upstream_rank: 0, demonstrating that upstream provenance ranks were not matched to the coverage records.
Behavioural criteria require preserving record_id/source provenance and ranking unsupported needs first, then preserving upstream provenance order.
initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a provenance handoff fault. The downstream outcome shows every priority has upstream_rank 0 because the evidence_sources handoff uses source identities such as s01 as record_id, while the needs and coverage records use demand record identities such as n06-r01. The supplied source for assemble_provenance localizes this: it writes record_id from record.get('source_id') instead of preserving the demand record_id, breaking the downstream rank join and violating the requirement to preserve record identities and upstream provenance order.
